summary: 2026-10-07 US post-market read: the composite closed at 49.43, down 1.11 on the day, still caution with the goldilocks regime intact. The move was a broad de-rating of the AI and high-beta complex rather than a macro shock: 18 of the 22 sectors and themes fell, led by quantum computing -3.1611, data centers -2.5749 and semiconductor equipment -2.4353, while digital advertising +0.8065 and semis +0.3908 were the exceptions. Large-cap semis split rather than fell together - NVDA -0.9432 to 236.983505, AMD -0.85 to 643.900024, AVGO -0.3965 and TSLA -0.9141 against MU +3.753 to 1084.800049. The macro leg stayed the binding constraint at 73.08: the 10-year yield moved 5.28 to 5.31 and the 10-year real rate 2.92 to 2.95, both at the 100th percentile, with the 2-year at 4.83 to 4.84 and the curve at 0.45 to 0.47. Credit and volatility moved the other way - HY OAS 3.12 to 3.03, IG 0.84 to 0.83 and VIX 15.52 to 15.01. Participation stayed narrow: breadth 0.6 of 155 names, only 8 new highs against 14 new lows of 156, small-cap relative -9.8896. Cross-asset confirmation held at 0.625, its 7.5 contribution still the largest single item, with 5 of the 8 production signals triggered, and reverse repo refilled 0.414 to 2.338. Policy pricing stayed hawkish, Fedwatch implying 4.065 against the delivered 3.88. Two data caveats: the dollar leg did not advance, still carrying its 2026-10-02 vintage at 121.3848 against 121.7882, and the rates vintage sits at 2026-10-05, 2 sessions behind the layer. A-shares remain frozen - XSHG is closed from 2026-10-01 through 2026-10-07 and reopens 2026-10-08 - so no mainland close is cited.

top_risk_drivers.claim: The macro leg is still the binding constraint at 73.08: the 10-year yield rose to 5.31 from 5.28 and the 10-year real rate to 2.95 from 2.92, both at the 100th percentile, while the 2-year moved to 4.84 from 4.83 and the curve steepened to 0.47 from 0.45.
The day's de-rating was broad rather than thematic: 18 of the 22 sectors and themes fell, with quantum computing -3.1611, data centers -2.5749 and semiconductor equipment -2.4353 leading the decline.

Cross-asset confirmation kept the largest single contribution at 7.5 on a reading of 0.625, with 5 of the 8 production signals triggered: the broad dollar index at 121.3848 is still above its threshold, the real rate at 2.95 above its own, and small-cap relative performance at -9.8896 remains deeply negative.
Household inflation expectations are not easing: the New York Fed's survey put the 1-year consumer inflation expectation at its highest since 2023-05.

Policy is priced for a hike and the communication now confirms it: Fedwatch implies 4.065 against the delivered rate of 3.88, and the minutes of the 2026-09 meeting record unanimous support for that hike.

supporting_signals.claim: Breadth is thinning rather than broadening: of 155 qualifying names only 0.6 sit above MA200, and of 156 considered names just 8 made new highs against 14 new lows.

Semiconductor leadership narrowed on both axes: the semis sector held +0.3908 while semis relative performance fell to -3.1545, semiconductor equipment to -2.4353 and the wider semiconductors theme to -1.0959.
The de-rating reached the industrial and mobility themes, not just software: industrial automation -2.354, autonomous driving -2.1048, EV supply chain -1.9239 and auto -0.9141.
Crypto de-rated alongside equities: bitcoin traded at 83392, ether at 2562.4 and solana at 116.08.

contradicting_signals.claim: Credit did not confirm the equity move: HY OAS tightened to 3.03 from 3.12 and IG OAS to 0.83 from 0.84.
Volatility fell rather than rose: VIX eased to 15.01 from 15.52 on a 2026-10-06 vintage, so the low-volatility reading is a live observation rather than a frozen series.

The dollar leg did not advance for a second run: it still carries its 2026-10-02 vintage at 121.3848 from 121.7882, so the dollar-strength signal and the 7.5 cross-asset contribution rest on a stale input.
Liquidity and participation held: reverse repo refilled to 2.338 from 0.414 and breadth stayed at 0.6 of 155 names.
The rates input lags the layer: the 5.31 and 2.95 observations carry a 2026-10-05 vintage, 2 sessions behind the 2026-10-07 layer date.

what_changed_today: The composite eased 1.11 to 49.43; of the six dimensions only equity_structure worsened, rising to 48.94, while liquidity_credit improved to 53.29 and volatility to 17.49.
Rates printed their first new observation since 2026-10-02: the 10-year yield at 5.31 and the 10-year real rate at 2.95 both sit at the 100th percentile.
Credit tightened a further notch: HY OAS to 3.03 from 3.12 and IG OAS to 0.83 from 0.84.
Volatility kept falling: VIX eased to 15.01 from 15.52.

The AI and infrastructure complex de-rated broadly - 18 of the 22 sectors and themes fell, quantum computing -3.1611, data centers -2.5749, semiconductor equipment -2.4353, industrial automation -2.354 - while digital advertising +0.8065, semis +0.3908 and fintech +0.0735 bucked the tape.
Large-cap semis split rather than falling together: MU +3.753 to 1084.800049 against NVDA -0.9432 to 236.983505, AMD -0.85 to 643.900024, AVGO -0.3965 and TSLA -0.9141 to 377.200012.
Reverse repo refilled to 2.338 from 0.414 on a same-day 2026-10-07 vintage.
The dollar leg did not advance: still at 121.3848 from 121.7882 on its 2026-10-02 vintage.
The FOMC minutes for the 2026-09 meeting were released after the session, recording unanimous support for the September hike and a majority leaning toward one more by year-end.
A-shares stayed closed: XSHG is shut from 2026-10-01 through 2026-10-07 and reopens 2026-10-08, so the mainland close is unchanged and no A-share number is cited.
Fedwatch implied rate 4.065 against the delivered 3.88, keeping the hike bias in place.
watch_next: Whether the 10-year at 5.31 and the real rate at 2.95, both at the 100th percentile, start to bite on the AI complex or the de-rating stalls.
Whether the dollar leg prints a fresh observation - its vintage is still 2026-10-02 - given that the dollar-strength signal and the 7.5 cross-asset contribution depend on it.
Whether credit keeps improving: HY OAS 3.03 and IG OAS 0.83 are the cleanest offset to the equity de-rating.
Whether breadth recovers from 8 new highs against 14 new lows of 156 names.
The high-importance US data: CPI on 2026-10-14, then PPI and advance retail sales on 2026-10-15.
The Q3 earnings season opening on 2026-10-13 with C, GS, JNJ, JPM, UNH and WFC, then TSM on 2026-10-15.
Whether the hawkish pricing survives: Fedwatch implies 4.065 against dff 3.88, while the minutes show no appetite for a series of hikes.
The reopening of XSHG on 2026-10-08, which restores the A-share leg after the 2026-10-01 to 2026-10-07 holiday.

bull_case.title: Bull case: credit and volatility keep offsetting the equity tape
points: HY OAS at 3.03 and IG OAS at 0.83 are the tightest reads in the layer, so corporate stress is not confirming the equity move.
VIX fell to 15.01 and its vintage advanced to 2026-10-06, so the low-volatility reading is a live observation rather than a frozen one.
The composite is only 49.43 with the goldilocks regime intact and model confidence at 0.9062.
A-shares reopen on 2026-10-08, restoring the second leg of the risk read, while 4 of the 22 sectors and themes still advanced today.

base_case.title: Base case: a narrow de-rating inside an intact goldilocks regime
points: The composite holds in the 45.0 to 55.0 band with the macro leg at 73.08 and cross-asset confirmation at 0.625.
Credit and volatility keep offsetting the tape, as they did today with HY OAS at 3.03 and VIX at 15.01.
The AI complex de-rates in rotation rather than in unison: 4 of the 22 sectors and themes still advanced.
Policy stays priced for a hike, Fedwatch implying 4.065 against dff 3.88, without forcing a repricing.

bear_case.title: Bear case: the de-rating broadens and breadth breaks below 0.6
points: The decline is already wide - 18 of the 22 sectors and themes fell, quantum computing -3.1611, data centers -2.5749, semiconductor equipment -2.4353 - so a further leg would not need a new catalyst.
Breadth is thinning: 155 qualifying names at 0.6 above MA200, and only 8 new highs against 14 new lows of 156.
The 10-year at 5.31 and the real rate at 2.95 sit at the 100th percentile, leaving no valuation cushion for a high-multiple AI complex.
Semis relative has already turned negative at -3.1545 even though the semis sector held +0.3908, and small-cap relative sits at -9.8896.
A-shares are still frozen and cannot confirm or deny the US read until XSHG reopens on 2026-10-08.
